questions.question: Which language should the frontend use?
questions.rationale: The specification explicitly requires vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.

options.label: JavaScript
options.description: Vanilla JavaScript without a UI framework.

questions.question: Which frontend framework or approach should be used?
questions.rationale: The specification explicitly excludes React and requests a vanilla frontend.

options.label: Vanilla JavaScript (no framework)
options.description: Use browser APIs and modular JavaScript; no React or other framework.

questions.question: What frontend features and implementation constraints are required?
questions.answer: Bulgarian MG4 EV Urban order/delivery tracker; single Firestore document named tracker/data with a cars array; realtime Firestore listener; transaction-based updates; configurable timeline; filters; admin CRUD; robust date handling and validation; privacy notice and anonymization; approximate-date visualization; safe idempotent initial import; verify official Bulgarian MG4 Urban color options; preserve the exact seed dataset from the supplied specification; document Firestore document-size and concurrent-write caveats; provide a Bulgarian README and security/error test checklist. Responsive UI. Firebase Hosting and Firebase Authentication email/password for admin; Firestore security rules restricted to a predefined admin UID. Firebase Spark-compatible; no React, custom backend, Cloud Functions, Cloud Storage, or Firebase Admin SDK.
questions.rationale: These requirements are stated in the supplied project specification.

questions.question: Which data stores does the application need?
questions.rationale: The specification requires Firestore persistence using one tracker/data document.

options.label: Firestore
options.description: Firebase document database for the tracker data and realtime updates.

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: The app does not persist application data.

questions.question: Do users need to sign in for application features?
questions.rationale: The specification requires email/password sign-in for administrators.

options.label: Yes
options.description: Administrators sign in to manage tracker data.
